final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT c.*, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT tif AS time_in_force, n AS distinct_orders, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY tif
